name: Tobias Wenlock-Aird
headline: Platform Engineer
summary: Platform engineer with twelve years in infrastructure, the last six building internal developer platforms. I run production Kubernetes clusters on Azure, own the infrastructure as code repositories and keep deployment pipelines boring and reliable. I prefer small, well-documented building blocks that product teams can adopt without asking for help.

bullets: Operate 6 Kubernetes clusters on AKS serving 140 microservices, with zero unplanned control plane outages in three years.
Built a self-service golden path: a team scaffolds a service and gets Bicep modules, Helm chart and pipeline in under 20 minutes.
Moved release process to GitOps with ArgoCD, cutting average deployment lead time from 2 days to 40 minutes.
Introduced cost dashboards and node pool right-sizing, saving 31% on monthly cloud spend.
Migrated a fleet of Windows and Linux VMs to containers and a first Kubernetes cluster on-premises.
Wrote Ansible roles and Jenkins pipelines used by 12 development teams.
Carried the on-call rota and wrote the incident runbooks the team still uses.
Managed Linux servers, backups and monitoring for a 60-person software house.
Automated server builds with shell scripts and Puppet.

name: Dulce Caramelo Vasconcellos
headline: Engenheira de Plataforma
summary: Engenheira de plataforma com oito anos de experiência em cloud e automação. Desenho e opero clusters Kubernetes em AWS, defino a infraestrutura em código com Terraform e mantenho pipelines de entrega contínua para equipas de produto. Valorizo observabilidade, segurança por defeito e documentação clara.

bullets: Gestão de clusters Kubernetes em EKS com mais de 90 serviços, com upgrades trimestrais sem downtime.
Infraestrutura em código com Terraform, organizada em módulos reutilizáveis e revistos por pares.
Pipelines GitLab CI com testes, análise de vulnerabilidades em imagens e promoção automática entre ambientes.
Definição de SLOs e alertas no Datadog, reduzindo o ruído de alertas em 45%.
Migração de aplicações monolíticas para contentores Docker e Kubernetes.
Automatização de ambientes de teste com scripts Python e Terraform.
Apoio às equipas de desenvolvimento na resolução de incidentes em produção.

name: Kwabena Asamoah-Tetteh
headline: Cloud Platform Engineer
summary: Junior cloud engineer, two years in the field after a graduate programme. I help run a Kubernetes platform on Google Cloud, write Terraform for new environments and fix pipeline failures. Eager to learn, comfortable with on-call shadowing and keen on reliability work.

bullets: Support a Kubernetes platform on GKE used by 25 engineers: namespace onboarding, resource quotas and access requests.
Write Terraform changes for new projects and networks, reviewed by senior engineers.
Maintain GitHub Actions workflows that build, scan and publish container images.
Resolved 60+ support tickets from development teams in the first year.
Rotated through the networking, cloud and monitoring teams.
Built a Python tool that reports unused cloud resources every week.
